_meta.note: Korean overlays for BRITAIN.TLK. Keys are classic English as TalkTlk loads them (look after fix_look). Noun-first topicN / topicN_aliases only. See .cursor/rules/talk-locale-ko-nouns.mdc

npcs.name: Iolo
npcs.response1:
I play my lute
and receive the
good wishes of
the people.
npcs.response2:
If you treat
someone else
well then they
will have reason
to do the same.
npcs.question:
Do you like
my music?

ko.name: 이올로
ko.response2:
남을 잘 대하면
그들도 같은 연민으로
답할 이유가
생깁니다.
ko.question:
내 음악이
마음에 드나요?

npcs.name: Gweno
npcs.job:
I dance and
sing for the
children.
npcs.response1:
Dance is good
for the soul.
npcs.response2:
To give to a
beggar shows
compassion.
npcs.question:
Do you give
to the needy?
npcs.yes:
Beggars are
thankful for
small donations.

npcs.name: a child
npcs.response1:
The song goes:
Ho eyo he hum!
npcs.response2:
It means:
Love to one
and all!
npcs.question:
Do you like
the song?
npcs.yes:
Then help us
spread the word!

ko.name: 아이
ko.response1:
노래는 이래요:
호 에요 헤 흠!
ko.question:
노래가
마음에 드나요?

npcs.name: a guard
npcs.response1:
Across the
bridge our
people dance
and sing!
npcs.question:
Would thou like
to join them?
npcs.yes:
Remember, an
open heart is
the first step
on the path to
wisdom!
npcs.no:
Then you have
no business
across the
bridge.

ko.name: 경비병
ko.response1:
다리 너머에서
우리 사람들이
춤추고 노래합니다!
ko.question:
그들과 함께하고
싶소?
ko.yes:
기억하시오.
열린 마음이
지혜의 길로 가는
첫걸음이오!

npcs.name: Pepper
npcs.response2:
The rune of
compassion lies
at the end of a
hall somewhere
in this towne.
npcs.question:
Dost thou seek
something?
npcs.no:
Alas, I may have
been able to
help.

ko.name: 페퍼
ko.response2:
연민의 룬은
이 마을 어디
복도 끝에
있소.
ko.question:
무엇을
찾고 있소?

npcs.name: Thevel
npcs.job:
I search for
the mystery of
the magic orbs.
npcs.response1:
A one-handed
beggar knows
their secrets!
npcs.question:
Hast thou
seen him?
npcs.yes:
Only he knows
the orb's gift!
npcs.no:
Find him in
Serpent castle
for he knows of
orbs!

ko.name: 세벨
ko.response1:
한 손 거지가
그 비밀을
알고 있소!
ko.question:
그를 본 적이
있소?

npcs.name: Joe
npcs.job:
Yo ho ho...
and a bottle...
of rum...
hic...
npcs.response1:
The yellow stone
is in the
dungeon
Despise...
npcs.question: Give me rum?...
npcs.yes:
Thanxth...
my friend Joe
can help with
the stones...
hic...

ko.name: 조
ko.job:
요 호 호…
럼 한 병…
딸꾹…
ko.question: 럼 좀…?
ko.yes:
고맙…
내 친구 조가
돌을 도와줄 수
있소…
딸꾹…

npcs.name: Cricket
npcs.response2:
The mantra for
the shrine of
compassion
is 'MU'!
npcs.question:
Now wilt thou
be quiet?
npcs.no:
I am going to
call the guards!

npcs.name: a guard
npcs.job:
I am a guard
of course!
npcs.response1:
We guards have
a lot of
compassion.
npcs.response2:
We always say:
Let all others'
troubles be as
thine own!
npcs.question:
Dost thou kill
non-evil
creatures?

ko.name: 경비병
ko.response2:
늘 말하오:
남의 근심을
네 근심처럼!
ko.question:
악하지 않은
생물을 죽이오?

npcs.name: a child
npcs.response1:
The solution to
ones problems
often lies in
solving others!
npcs.response2:
Never care so
much for thyself
that thou cannot
care for others!
npcs.question:
Know ye the
mantra of
compassion?

ko.name: 아이
ko.job:
나는 배움을 통해
연민을 익히고 있어요.
ko.response1:
자기 문제의 해답은
종종 남의 문제를
푸는 데 있어요!
ko.response2:
남을 보살필 여유조차
없을 만큼
자신만 돌보지 마세요!
ko.question:
연민의 만트라를
아세요?

npcs.name: Shalimar
npcs.response1:
It takes a
good deal of
compassion to
deal with
children!
npcs.response2:
Compassion
strengthens the
soul as
knowledge
tempers the
mind!
npcs.question: Have any kids?
npcs.yes:
Thou dost know
what I mean!

ko.name: 샬리마
ko.response2:
연민은 영혼을
강하게 하고,
지식은 마음을
단련합니다!
ko.question: 아이가 있습니까?

npcs.name: Sebastian
npcs.response1:
Mondain's
influence has
not left the
world!
npcs.response2:
An artifact
remains! I heard
at Buccaneer's
Den!
npcs.question:
Wilt thou find
and destroy it?
npcs.yes:
Then ask at the
pub there of
the skull!

ko.name: 세바스티안
ko.response1:
몬데인의 영향은
아직 세상을
떠나지 않았소!
ko.question:
그것을 찾아서
부수겠소?

npcs.name: Shapero
npcs.response1:
He knows the
true nature of
compassion.
npcs.response2:
Seek out Julio
and ask him of
compassion!
npcs.question:
Art thou on the
Quest of the
Avatar?
npcs.yes:
Find the shrine
of compassion
east across 2
bridges!

ko.name: 샤페로
ko.question:
아바타의 퀘스트
중이오?
ko.yes:
연민의 사원은
동쪽으로 다리 둘을
건너시오!

npcs.name: Julio
npcs.job:
I seek the
true nature
of things!
npcs.response1:
All things have
a true nature!
npcs.response2:
Compassion
derives itself
from unending
love!
npcs.question:
Dost thou know
the true nature
of all things?
npcs.yes:
Thou art a liar
and a braggart.

npcs.name: Mentor
npcs.response1:
Pride was too
great in
Magincia!
npcs.response2:
The city was
destroyed by
daemons for
its pride!
npcs.question: Art thou proud?
npcs.no:
Pride exists
without truth,
love, or
courage!

ko.name: 멘토
ko.response2:
그 도시가 자만
때문에 악마들에게
멸망했소!
ko.question: 자만하오?

npcs.name: Sprite
npcs.job:
I have no job so
now I beg!
npcs.health:
I fear I
shall die of
starvation!
npcs.response1:
I have not eaten
in a week!
npcs.question:
Wilt thou
help me?
npcs.yes:
In return I
shall tell thee
that Pepper
knows of the
rune!

ko.name: 스프라이트
ko.question:
저를 도와
주시겠습니까?
ko.yes:
답례로 말씀드리면,
페퍼가 룬에 대해
알고 있습니다!
